mobile-mainmobilesettingsintegration--di.expression: () => { const root=document.querySelector('[data-main-mobile-settings]'); const buttons=[...root.querySelectorAll('button')]; return root.dataset.mainMobileSettings==='non-owner' ? !!root.querySelector('p') && buttons.length===0 : buttons.some(b=>b.textContent.includes('Worktree setup')) && buttons.some(b=>b.textContent.includes('Project skills')); }
